dimensions.note: The extension holds no credentials and reads no vault. Since 2026.11.10.1, refused JSON text is no longer echoed: argument errors say only "isn't valid JSON." and import says "<path> isn't valid JSON, so nothing was imported.", because V8's JSON.parse messages quote about ten characters of the input. A test sends a short synthetic secret in three malformed forms and checks it appears in no validation error, thrown error, stack, log or written data.

record_router_test logs the change line every method logs and, like record_build_result, what stops the release when the request isn't released. Logs carry ids, numbers, statuses and the plain-word problems, not emails.

candidateExtensions, specification (edit and revise) and review now go through one jsonOr() preprocess: text that isn't JSON is a zod validation issue, not a raw SyntaxError, and the method never runs. import catches JSON.parse and raises invalid_input; valid JSON that isn't a snapshot is still refused by SnapshotSchema before any write. A missing import file still surfaces Deno's NotFound, naming the path the caller gave.

69 tests pass (287 steps). New since 2026.11.10.1: for each of the four JSON-text arguments, native and JSON-text forms read the same, malformed text is one issue on that path with the fixed message, wrong-shaped JSON is refused, a synthetic secret never leaks, and a refused call writes no records and no logs. For import: three malformed files and five wrong shapes (null, array, wrong format, bad person, bad request after a good person) write nothing. The leak and malformed-file tests fail on the previous code.
The same build result twice and now the same router test twice change nothing and still write the request to the method output. A new test for a version replaces the last; history keeps every test.

build-result/v2 is read as Factory's contract (factory#139): recipe {id 1–200, phrases 1–50 trimmed, empty trimmed non-blank}. v1 still parses, but under Mark's decision on factory#78 a v1 result can no longer release a request; Factory's -result writes v1 until this version is published and then switches to v2. Requests already Released keep their status; the rule is applied when something new is recorded.
No new files, sockets or timers. record_router_test reads and writes one request through the existing store.
The manifest description, README and ADR-004 name record_router_test and the new Released rule. The archive holds the same files as 2026.11.09.2 with build_result_v1.ts renamed build_result.ts.

Argument schemas are unchanged; jsonOr only replaces the inline JSON.parse preprocess. Import still validates with SnapshotSchema; its error embeds zod's issue list, which in zod 4.6.5 describes the expected shape, not the received value.
routerTests grows by one entry per changed test on a request, bounded by how often the owner retests; identical retries add nothing. No data is written outside the request.
Router tests are recorded and read on the request and page; they're never edited in place, a new test replaces the last for its version, as build results work.

Malformed arguments are refused during argument parsing, before any service call. import parses and validates the whole snapshot before saving anything; a storage failure partway through saving could still leave a partial import, which bad input can't trigger.
No new data names: record_router_test writes request-<id> as other methods do.

Only the request's outcome owner can record a router test; builders, reviewers and observers get not_allowed, and someone who can't see the request gets not_found from the existing load. An outcome owner who is a builder may now start building (#45); the role check is still per request.
Both behaviors move to 2026.11.16.1 with no-op upgrade entries; settings and stored data are unchanged, so nothing needs migrating.
